scripts.db:create: npm run db:create:production & npm run db:create:dev & npm run db:create:test
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:reset:production & npm run db:reset:dev & npm run db:reset:test
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate:production & npm run db:migrate:dev & npm run db:migrate:test
scripts.db:seed: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run db:seed:production & cross-env NODE_ENV=dev npm run db:seed:dev & cross-env NODE_ENV=test npm run db:seed:test

scripts.db:setup:dev: npm run db:create:dev & npm run db:migrate:dev & npm run db:seed:dev
scripts.db:setup:test: npm run db:create:test & npm run db:migrate:test & npm run db:seed:test
